decks.notes: This deck aims to utilize a variety of creatures to quickly assemble a powerful combo that can overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can tutor for specific creatures such as Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to create powerful synergies on the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Wall of Roots and Birds of Paradise help ramp up mana production, while cards like Endurance and Blood Artist provide additional utility and disruption to the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to generate a winning advantage.

Utilizing a mix of Elementals and control cards, this deck focuses on powerful mana ramp and card advantage to dominate the battlefield. With Omnath, Locus of Creation at the center of its strategy, the deck aims to quickly ramp up mana and gain multiple triggers to overwhelm the opponent. Support cards like Risen Reef and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional advantage and disruption, while Leyline Binding helps to control the board and protect your creatures. The deck's key concept lies in its ability to generate massive value and tempo to outpace the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Indomitable Creativity card to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play quickly. The key strategy involves setting up a board state with cards like Wrenn and Six, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Prismari Command to generate tokens or ramp mana, then using Indomitable Creativity to convert those tokens or lands into game-winning threats. The deck also includes control elements like Mana Leak, Spell Pierce, and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck is focused on utilizing creatures with sacrifice abilities and the toolbox nature of Eldritch Evolution to generate value and combo potential. The key strategy is to use creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to control the board and generate additional value by sacrificing creatures. By utilizing creatures like Strangleroot Geist and Geralf's Messenger, along with versatile spells like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling, this deck aims to create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential and toolbox of creatures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing fast, aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to pressure the opponent early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure. Additionally, cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Feign Death provide card advantage and board presence. The inclusion of removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt helps to clear the way for the aggressive creatures to deal damage. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays using efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board and protect its threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. By using cantrips like Consider and Mishra's Bauble, the deck maintains card advantage and smooths out draws. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat in the late game, while cards like Ledger Shredder and Unholy Heat help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and applying pressure on the opponent through fast and efficient attacks. It utilizes low cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to control the tempo of the game. Card advantage is gained through spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, while also having disruptive elements with Counterspell and Force of Negation. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive strategy and versatile arsenal of spells to secure a victory.

The deck aims to ramp up its mana quickly by utilizing cards like Arboreal Grazer, Sakura-Tribe Elder, and Amulet of Vigor to cast Primeval Titan as soon as possible. Once Primeval Titan is on the battlefield, it can search for lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive amounts of damage. The deck also has tools like Tolaria West and Expedition Map to search for key pieces like Boseiju, Who Endures to protect its combo, ultimately leading to a powerful win condition through a combination of land synergies and powerful creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also utilizes Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its creatures and generate value. Blood Moon and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional disruption, while cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt offer removal options. Overall, this deck aims to be fast, disruptive, and resilient in order to secure a victory in a Modern 1 vs 1 match.

The deck focuses on assembling the Colossus Hammer combo with Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly create a powerful creature. It includes tools like Sigarda's Aid and Blacksmith's Skill to protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponent's strategies. To support the combo, the deck includes various equipment and utility creatures like Esper Sentinel and Nettlecyst. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a massive, unblockable threat.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on being fast and disruptive, with a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer combined with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate. The deck relies on disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while utilizing Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect and recur your creatures. The deck also includes powerful hate cards like Blood Moon to punish certain strategies, making it a versatile and aggressive choice for Modern 1 vs 1 gameplay.

Utilizing equipment and small creature synergies, this deck aims to quickly assemble powerful combinations to overwhelm the opponent. The main focus is on equipping Colossus Hammer onto creatures like Inkmoth Nexus or Ornithopter, supported by Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to enable fast, explosive plays. Urza's Saga provides versatile tutoring options, while Stoneforge Mystic fetches key equipment pieces. The deck also includes protection and evasion tools like Shadowspear and Sword of Fire and Ice to ensure the combos go off smoothly while keeping the opponent on the back foot.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of red, green, and blue spells and creatures to control the board and put pressure on the opponent. It utilizes Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and other efficient threats like Tarmogoyf and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly apply pressure. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Mana Leak and Unholy Heat to control the opponent's plays. With a mix of card advantage from Expressive Iteration and card selection from Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga, this deck aims to close out the game swiftly while maintaining some control over the board.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly deploy artifact creatures and artifacts to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By utilizing cards like Esper Sentinel and Metallic Rebuke for control, along with cards like Springleaf Drum and Urza's Saga for additional mana and card advantage, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and close out the game swiftly. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and synergizes well with the overall game plan of the deck.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence and tempo through a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon?s Rage Channeler, backed up by disruption spells like Spell Snare and Counterspell. Unholy Heat serves as efficient removal while Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and digging for threats. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game by denying the opponent's key spells with counters and disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost and efficient spells to control the board and put pressure on the opponent early in the game. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to chip away at their life total. The deck also includes card draw and filtering effects to ensure a consistent stream of threats. By maintaining tempo and applying pressure consistently, the UR Aggro deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.
